seasons.name: Rookie Cup
seasons.sub: Six rounds on the Amateur tracks. Dusty thinks it is his.

rival.name: Dusty
rival.intro: Dusty rides the orange bike. He has won this cup twice and says so.
rival.ahead: Dusty: Nice start. Ovals are easy. Wait for the gulch.
rival.behind: Dusty: Told you. Save your sprockets for a bus ticket.
rival.won: Dusty: Fine. You were faster. The Pro Tour is a different animal.
rival.lost: Dusty: Two for me, zero for you. Come back when the bike is real.

seasons.name: Pro Tour
seasons.sub: Eight rounds on the Pro tracks, mirrors and reverses included.

rival.name: Rico
rival.intro: Rico does not talk much. He wins on the mud and expects you to fall in it.
rival.behind: Rico: You are learning the lines. Slowly.
rival.won: Rico: Good. Mags is waiting. She does not lose.

seasons.name: Ironman Series
seasons.sub: Eight rounds. Reverse laps, long races, and the Den to finish.

rival.name: Mags
rival.intro: Mags has never lost a series. She has the Den memorized.
rival.ahead: Mags: The Den decides it. Not the points.
rival.behind: Mags: Keep up or go home.
rival.won: Mags: Nobody has done that. Enjoy it. I will not let it happen twice.
rival.lost: Mags: As expected. The Den is mine.
